Az ÖSSZES hibát megkeresed a kódban Az elsőtől az utolsóig minden karaktert átnézel Csak a konkrét pontos hibákat mindet írod Listába  majd ha megtalaltad az osszes hibat teljes kódot kijavítva vissza küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód  egy kód mezőbe írjad a teljes kódot es legyen 100% osan hiba mentes!  es arra törekedj hogy mindenben a kód a lehető legfejlettebb legjobb teljesítményű leggyorsabb és mindenben a legjobb legyen! 

import scala.math._
import scala.collection.mutable
import scala.util.Random

object InteractionNodeType extends Enumeration {
  val App, Lambda, Dup, Era, Fan, Tag, Constructor, Debug, Pad = Value
}

case class InteractionPort(nodeId: Long, portIdx: Int)

case class InteractionNode(
  nodeType: InteractionNodeType.Value,
  portPrimary: InteractionPort,
  portAux1: InteractionPort,
  portAux2: InteractionPort,
  var rewriteCount: Long
)

case class InteractionEdge(
  srcPort: InteractionPort,
  dstPort: InteractionPort,
  edgeId: Long
)

class HVMRuntime {
  private val nodes = mutable.ArrayBuffer
  private val edges = mutable.ArrayBuffer
  private var rewriteCount: Long = 0
  private var nodeIdCounter: Long = 0

  def createNode(nodeType: InteractionNodeType.Value): Long = {
    val nodeId = nodeIdCounter
    nodeIdCounter += 1

    val node = InteractionNode(
      nodeType,
      InteractionPort(nodeId, 0),
      InteractionPort(nodeId, 1),
      InteractionPort(nodeId, 2),
      0
    )

    nodes += node
    nodeId
  }

  def connectNodes(src: InteractionPort, dst: InteractionPort): Unit = {
    val edge = InteractionEdge(src, dst, edges.length.toLong)
    edges += edge
  }

  def rewriteAppLam(appId: Long, lamId: Long): Unit = {
    if appId < nodes.length && lamId < nodes.length then
      val appNode = nodes(appId.toInt)
      val lamNode = nodes(lamId.toInt)

      if appNode.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.App && lamNode.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Lambda then
        val dupId = createNode(InteractionNodeType.Dup)
        val dupNode = nodes(dupId.toInt)

        connectNodes(appNode.portAux1, dupNode.portPrimary)
        rewriteCount += 1

  def rewriteDupEra(dupId: Long, eraId: Long): Unit = {
    if dupId < nodes.length && eraId < nodes.length then
      val dupNode = nodes(dupId.toInt)
      val eraNode = nodes(eraId.toInt)

      if dupNode.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Dup && eraNode.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Era then
        val era1Id = createNode(InteractionNodeType.Era)
        val era2Id = createNode(InteractionNodeType.Era)

        val era1Node = nodes(era1Id.toInt)
        val era2Node = nodes(era2Id.toInt)

        connectNodes(dupNode.portAux1, era1Node.portPrimary)
        connectNodes(dupNode.portAux2, era2Node.portPrimary)
        rewriteCount += 1

  def evaluate(maxIterations: Long = 10000): Unit = {
    var iteration = 0L

    while iteration < maxIterations do
      var rewrote = false

      for i <- 0 until nodes.length - 1 do
        if nodes(i).nodeType == InteractionNodeType.App && nodes(i + 1).nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Lambda then
          rewriteAppLam(i.toLong, (i + 1).toLong)
          rewrote = true
          break
        else if nodes(i).nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Dup && nodes(i + 1).nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Era then
          rewriteDupEra(i.toLong, (i + 1).toLong)
          rewrote = true
          break

      if !rewrote then return

      iteration += 1

  def stats(): (Int, Int, Long, Int, Int, Int, Int) = {
    val appCount = nodes.count(_.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.App)
    val lamCount = nodes.count(_.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Lambda)
    val dupCount = nodes.count(_.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Dup)
    val eraCount = nodes.count(_.nodeType == InteractionNodeType.Era)

    (nodes.length, edges.length, rewriteCount, appCount, lamCount, dupCount, eraCount)
  }
}

class UnifiedTokenizer {
  private val vocabSize = 131072
  private val embeddingDim = 131072
  private val pAdicBasis = new Array[Double](embeddingDim)
  private val astroEmbeddings = new Array[Double](embeddingDim)

  for i <- 0 until embeddingDim do
    val base = i.toDouble / embeddingDim.toDouble
    pAdicBasis(i) = base / 2.0 + 0.5

    val angle = 2.0 * Pi * i.toDouble / 360.0
    astroEmbeddings(i) = sin(angle) * 0.5 + 0.5

  def encode(text: String): Vector[Int] = {
    var tokens = mutable.ArrayBuffer
    var hashVal: Int = 0

    for char <- text do
      hashVal = ((hashVal << 5) + hashVal) ^ char.toInt
      tokens += (hashVal % vocabSize).toInt

    tokens.toVector
  }

  def embed(tokens: Vector[Int]): Vector[Double] = {
    tokens.map { token =>
      val idx = (token.abs % embeddingDim)
      val pAdicVal = pAdicBasis(idx)
      val astroVal = astroEmbeddings(idx)
      pAdicVal * 0.6 + astroVal * 0.4
    }
  }

  def batchEncode(texts: Vector[String]): Vector[Vector[Int]] = {
    texts.map(encode)
  }

  def batchEmbed(tokenLists: Vector[Vector[Int]]): Vector[Vector[Double]] = {
    tokenLists.map(embed)
  }
}

class MemristorLayer(size: Int) {
  private val resistances = new Array[Double](size)
  private val conductances = new Array[Double](size)
  private val spikeHistory = new Array[Boolean](size)
  private val synapticWeights = new Array[Double](size)

  for i <- 0 until size do
    resistances(i) = 1000.0
    conductances(i) = 0.001
    spikeHistory(i) = false
    synapticWeights(i) = 0.1

  def forward(input: Vector[Double]): Vector[Double] = {
    var output = mutable.ArrayBuffer

    for (val, idx) <- input.zipWithIndex do
      if idx < resistances.length then
        val g = conductances(idx)
        val r = resistances(idx)
        val w = synapticWeights(idx)

        val voltageOut = val * w * (1.0 / (r + 1e-8)) * (1.0 + g * 0.1)
        val spike = if voltageOut > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0

        if spike > 0.5 then
          resistances(idx) = max(100.0, r - 10.0)
        else
          resistances(idx) = min(10000.0, r + 10.0)

        spikeHistory(idx) = spike > 0.5
        output += spike

    output.toVector
  }

  def updateResistances(): Unit = {
    for (spike, idx) <- spikeHistory.zipWithIndex do
      val delta = if spike then -10.0 else 10.0
      resistances(idx) += delta * 0.01
      resistances(idx) = max(100.0, min(10000.0, resistances(idx)))
  }
}

class QuantumPerturbationMatrix(dim: Int) {
  private val perturbations = new Array[Double](dim)
  private val amplitudes = new Array[Double](dim)
  private val phases = new Array[Double](dim)

  for i <- 0 until dim do
    perturbations(i) = (Random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.02
    amplitudes(i) = Random.nextDouble() * 0.01
    phases(i) = Random.nextDouble() * 2.0 * Pi

  def applyPerturbations(input: Vector[Double]): Vector[Double] = {
    input.zipWithIndex.map { case (val, idx) =>
      val pertIdx = idx % perturbations.length
      val + perturbations(pertIdx)
    }
  }
}

class UnifiedArchitecture {
  private val hvm = new HVMRuntime
  private val tokenizer = new UnifiedTokenizer
  private val memristorLayer = new MemristorLayer(18432)
  private val quantumInterface = new QuantumPerturbationMatrix(131072)
  
  private val weights = (0 until 12).map { _ =>
    (0 until 131072 * 18432).map { _ =>
      (Random.nextDouble() - 0.5) / sqrt(131072.0)
    }.toVector
  }.toVector

  private val biases = (0 until 12).map { _ =>
    Vector.fill(18432)(0.0)
  }.toVector

  def forward(inputTokens: Vector[Int]): Vector[Double] = {
    var hidden = tokenizer.embed(inputTokens)

    for layerIdx <- 0 until 12 do
      hidden = hidden.zipWithIndex.map { case (val, idx) =>
        val weightIdx = idx % weights(layerIdx).length
        val biasIdx = idx % biases(layerIdx).length

        max(0.0, weights(layerIdx)(weightIdx) * val + biases(layerIdx)(biasIdx))
      }

    val memristorOut = memristorLayer.forward(hidden)
    quantumInterface.applyPerturbations(memristorOut)
  }

  def backward(loss: Double): Unit = {
    for layerIdx <- 0 until 12 do
      weights(layerIdx).zipWithIndex.foreach { case (_, idx) =>
        weights(layerIdx)(idx) = weights(layerIdx)(idx) - 0.0001 * 0.001 * loss
      }

      biases(layerIdx).zipWithIndex.foreach { case (_, idx) =>
        biases(layerIdx)(idx) = biases(layerIdx)(idx) - 0.0001 * 0.0001 * loss
      }

    memristorLayer.updateResistances()
  }

  def trainingStep(text: String): Unit = {
    val tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
    val output = forward(tokens)

    var totalLoss = 0.0
    for val <- output do
      totalLoss += val * val
    totalLoss /= output.length.toDouble

    backward(totalLoss)
  }
}

object Jaide1 {
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = {
    println("Initializing Jaide 1 Scala Backend")
    val arch = new UnifiedArchitecture

    println("HVM Runtime initialized")
    val appNode = arch.hvm.createNode(InteractionNodeType.App)
    val lamNode = arch.hvm.createNode(InteractionNodeType.Lambda)

    arch.hvm.evaluate(10000)

    val (totalNodes, totalEdges, rewriteCount, appCount, lamCount, dupCount, eraCount) = arch.hvm.stats()
    println(s"Total nodes: $totalNodes")
    println(s"Total edges: $totalEdges")
    println(s"Total rewrites: $rewriteCount")
    println(s"APP nodes: $appCount")
    println(s"LAM nodes: $lamCount")
    println(s"DUP nodes: $dupCount")
    println(s"ERA nodes: $eraCount")

    val sampleText = "Jaide 1 unified neural architecture with Scala backend"
    val tokens = arch.tokenizer.encode(sampleText)
    println(s"Tokens encoded: ${tokens.length}")

    val output = arch.forward(tokens)
    println(s"Output vector size: ${output.length}")

    arch.trainingStep(sampleText)
    println("Training step complete")

    println("Jaide 1 Scala module ready")
  }
}
